title: Firing Membership
source_quote: Participate in 2 or more CMAEP Hosted Wood-Firing Workshops for 2 consecutive seasons.

_original.title: Firing Membership
_original.source_quote: Participate in 2 or more CMAEP Hosted Wood-Firing Workshops for 2 consecutive seasons.

summary: Membership program for repeat workshop participants who have attended 2+ wood-firing workshops in 2 consecutive seasons. Members receive discounts, reserved spots in workshops, and access to exclusive events.
bring: minimum 2 cubic feet for train firings, minimum 5 cubic feet for anagama firings
commitment: 2+ wood-firing workshops per season ongoing; 2+ crew shifts per firing (minimum 10pm–4am or 4am–10am for train firings, two shifts for anagama); 2 cu ft (train) or 5 cu ft (anagama) of work per firing
